verdict.rationale: Semgrep's own docs say it posts PR/MR comments: Semgrep Secrets 'informs developers of valid secrets in their PRs and MRs by posting comments directly', and its GitHub integration can 'automate PR comments'. CI jobs scan on pull and merge requests. Comment surfacing for general Code and Supply Chain findings is only implied, GitLab is never named explicitly (only 'MRs'), and status checks are not documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of PR/MR comments for all finding types (Code, Supply Chain), explicit GitLab merge-request integration docs, GitHub/GitLab status-check behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see scan findings surfaced as pull-request comments or checks in GitHub or GitLab

citations.quote: informs developers of valid secrets in their PRs and MRs by posting comments directly
You can use Semgrep and its GitHub integration to automate PR comments that you frequently make in code reviews.
your development cycle benefits from the automated scanning of repositories at various events, such as: Push events; Pull requests or merge requests
